title: A second save of the same matrix is refused with Reload
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a second browser session open, signed in as another Admin with the same permissions.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 60 in Default's first range.
  5. In the second session, save matrix A with Default on 70.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Default reads 60.

Step 5:

  • The second session saves matrix A with 70.

Step 6:

  • The save is refused with matrix A's name and "was changed by someone else. Reload to see their changes." on the page.
  • The grid still shows 60 in Default's first range.
  • A Reload action is offered beside the message.
